findings.title: For You intentionally empty when BACKEND_URL not configured
findings.observation: Page renders a clear message 'Recommendations require the optional ai-web-feeds backend service.' with links to /sources and deployment docs. No recommendations list or loading state shown for unauthenticated or unconfigured backend.
findings.impact: Feature surface is gated; users hitting the link directly may be confused unless they read the message. Not a bug per deployment model.
findings.recommendation: Ensure the empty state includes a stronger visual cue or CTA to the main reader. Consider hiding 'For You' nav item entirely when backend not configured.

findings.title: Dashboard lacks site footer consistent with hub surfaces
findings.observation: Page ends after operations card with no <footer> or secondary links. Matches prior hub observation.
findings.impact: Inconsistent chrome across surfaces; no copyright or policy links termination.
findings.recommendation: Add shared footer component to all non-docs routes including dashboard and for-you.

findings.title: Metric grid on dashboard stacks to single column on mobile with compact text
findings.observation: 4 metric cards (Sources, Verified, Topics, Validation) collapse to vertical stack. Text and progress bars remain readable but dense.
findings.impact: Usable but may feel cramped on very small viewports; no major breakage.
findings.recommendation: Consider 2-col explicit or adjust padding for mobile metrics.

passed_checks: dashboard renders live catalog stats without errors
for-you surfaces explicit backend requirement message
links to reader/sources from personal surfaces present
